content.title: Tracker Is Losing 2 Original Cast Members Before Season 3 After Season 2's Big Exit - IMDb
content.text: Tracker Is Losing 2 Original Cast Members Before Season 3 After Season 2's Big ExitTwo original Tracker cast members exit the crime drama ahead of season 3’s release. Tracker season 3's release is slated for October 19, as Justin Hartley's titular character, Colter Shaw, continues to take on challenging new cases.As reported by TVLine, Eric Graise and Abby McEnany, who played Bobby and Velma respectively, aren’t returning for Tracker season 3. Their exits come after Robin Weigert’s. She portrayed Velma’s wife Teddi, who was written out of the show after Tracker season 1’s ending, with her disappearance being motivated by Teddi and Velma separating.Graise and McEnany’s exits leave Tracker with only two original cast members who are series regulars – Hartley and Fiona Rene, who plays lawyer Reenie Greene.
